priogrid_source.crosswalk: INTERIM handover (#231): GAUL iso3_code -> VIEWS isoab -> country_id; duplicate isoab resolved to the most recently observed entity

Kosovo -> SRB/Serbia.note: GAUL 2024 has no Kosovo unit; its territory is coded SRB, so these cells crosswalk to VIEWS Serbia. VIEWS Kosovo (country_id 232) receives zero cells. Decision venue: views-datafactory#341 / views-postprocessing#123.

declared_zero_cell_countries.CSK: retired state (Czechoslovakia) — unique ISO, no successor collision
declared_zero_cell_countries.SUN: retired code (USSR) — GAUL 2024 has no SUN cells, successor codes hold them
declared_zero_cell_countries.YUG: retired code (Yugoslavia) — GAUL 2024 has no YUG cells
declared_zero_cell_countries.LUX: below 0.5-deg majority-cell scale — GAUL codes its cells to neighbours
declared_zero_cell_countries.GMB: narrower than a 0.5-deg cell — GAUL majority-codes its strip to Senegal

priogrid_semantics: latest known assignment per cell; months before a border change are labelled with the current country (declared limitation, see epic #204). Since #231 the assignment is a static GAUL-2024 snapshot crosswalked to VIEWS country ids (interim handover — see stamp priogrid_source)
